# Ollvy

> Ollvy is India's modern company registration and compliance platform. We help entrepreneurs register businesses, obtain necessary licenses, and stay compliant with Indian regulations - all online, with transparent pricing and real-time tracking.

## About

Ollvy simplifies business registration and compliance in India. Founded to make entrepreneurship accessible, we handle the paperwork so founders can focus on building. Our platform offers one-time registrations, recurring compliance filings, and expert guidance - all backed by practicing CAs and CS professionals.

- Website: https://www.ollvy.com
- Support: team@ollvy.com

## Services

### Company Registration
- [Private Limited Company Registration](https://www.ollvy.com/services/pvt-ltd-incorporation) - Register a Pvt Ltd with DSC, DIN, incorporation certificate
- [LLP Registration](https://www.ollvy.com/services/llp-incorporation) - Limited Liability Partnership with LLP Agreement
- [Company Name Change](https://www.ollvy.com/services/company-name-change) - Change your company's registered name with MCA

### Tax Registration
- [GST Registration](https://www.ollvy.com/services/gst-registration) - Get your GSTIN in 3-7 days
- [GST Cancellation](https://www.ollvy.com/services/gst-cancellation) - Voluntary GST cancellation
- [GST Revocation](https://www.ollvy.com/services/gst-revocation) - Revoke cancelled GST registration

### Tax Filing
- [Business ITR Filing](https://www.ollvy.com/services/business-itr) - Company and LLP income tax returns
- [GST Monthly Filing](https://www.ollvy.com/services/gst-monthly) - GSTR-1, GSTR-3B monthly compliance
- [TDS Monthly Compliance](https://www.ollvy.com/services/tds-monthly-compliance) - TDS return filing and payment

### Company Compliance
- [MCA Annual Filing](https://www.ollvy.com/services/mca-annual-filing) - AOC-4, MGT-7 annual returns
- [Director KYC](https://www.ollvy.com/services/director-kyc) - DIR-3 KYC for directors
- [DIN Reactivation](https://www.ollvy.com/services/din-reactivation) - Reactivate deactivated DIN

### Business Licenses
- [MSME/Udyam Registration](https://www.ollvy.com/services/msme-registration) - MSME certificate for benefits
- [Startup India DPIIT](https://www.ollvy.com/services/startup-india) - DPIIT recognition for startups
- [Trademark Registration](https://www.ollvy.com/services/trademark-registration) - Protect your brand name and logo
- [FSSAI License](https://www.ollvy.com/services/fssai-license) - Food business license
- [IEC Code](https://www.ollvy.com/services/iec-code) - Import Export Code for international trade
- [Cloud Kitchen Setup](https://www.ollvy.com/services/cloud-kitchen-setup) - Complete cloud kitchen compliance bundle

### Payroll Services
- [Payroll Management](https://www.ollvy.com/services/payroll-management) - Monthly payroll processing and compliance
